judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 7511, the Laken Riley Act, which required federal detention of immigrants charged with burglary, theft, larceny, or shoplifting. The House passed it 251-170.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 3602, which made it a federal crime to serve as a lookout or interfere with border enforcement for a smuggling group. It failed 215-199 under a fast-track process needing two-thirds support, so it did not become law.
